eyebrow: A CLEARER VIEW OF YOUR NEXT SEASON
title:
Know your field.
Choose with confidence.
intro: Bring your soil test and local weather together. Find crops that fit your conditions, with the reasoning and model health in view.
fieldTitle: A decision starts below the surface.
processTitle: A practical starting point. Three simple steps.
step1Body: Use a recent soil test for nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, and pH.
step2Body: Enter representative temperature, humidity, and rainfall for the growing season.
step3Body: Review three model matches and discuss your choice with a local agriculture officer.
trustTitle: Useful advice begins with honest limits.
trustBody: The repository reports 96.97% held-out accuracy for model v2. This is a dataset benchmark, not a promise of results on your farm. Live model metrics are shown only when the service supplies them.
